n.auth.wa-title: Send us this code on WhatsApp
n.auth.wa-body: Tap the button to open WhatsApp with the message ready, then press Send. It's free. Send it from the WhatsApp on {phone}.
n.auth.wa-number: Or send the code yourself to {number}.
n.auth.wa-mismatch: We got the code from a different number. Send it from the WhatsApp on {phone}, or go back and enter the number your WhatsApp uses.
n.auth.wa-expired: This code has expired. Start again for a new one.
n.auth.wa-safety: Only send it if you started this sign-in yourself.
n.auth.wa-fallback-whatsapp: Can't send it? Get a code on WhatsApp instead
n.auth.wa-fallback-sms: Get a code by SMS instead
n.auth.wa-offline: Can't reach Hawkeye — check your connection. We'll keep checking.
n.auth.wa-too-many: Too many tries for this number. Wait an hour, or get a code on WhatsApp instead.
n.auth.wa-invalid-phone: Enter a Nigerian mobile number, e.g. 08031234567.
